description: This file defines a Python class 'RedirectModel' that extends keras.callbacks.Callback to wrap another callback, redirecting its model during training. It is used within a TensorFlow/Keras project to facilitate callback management during model training.

classes.name: RedirectModel
classes.description: A callback class that wraps another callback and redirects its model during training.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RedirectModel with a callback and a model to redirect to.

methods.name: on_epoch_begin
methods.description: Delegates the epoch begin event to the wrapped callback.

methods.name: on_epoch_end
methods.description: Delegates the epoch end event to the wrapped callback.

methods.name: on_batch_begin
methods.description: Delegates the batch begin event to the wrapped callback.

methods.name: on_batch_end
methods.description: Delegates the batch end event to the wrapped callback.

methods.name: on_train_begin
methods.description: Overrides the model in the wrapped callback with the redirect model and starts training.

methods.name: on_train_end
methods.description: Delegates the training end event to the wrapped callback.
